label: HG cross-asset US opening-range reversal into the close (Monday longs) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `ES US opening-range reversal into the close (Monday longs)`. US opening reversal into the closing half-hour. Filter: long signals on weekday 0. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.56 over 65 trades; average planned RR 5.01, min planned RR 4.84; bootstrap p05 1.50, block-bootstrap p05 1.29, annual pass rate 75%.
